say: Thirteen big games today.
Leeds are unbeaten in eight at Elland Road.
Manchester United haven't won away this season.
And that's only the first battle.

title.sub: eight more games on the board
say: Sunday's five biggest games, as card battles. Let's turn them over.

battles.story: Leeds: unbeaten in eight at Elland Road. Man Utd: no win in four away games this season.
say: First battle, at two o'clock. Leeds are unbeaten in eight at Elland Road, and Manchester United haven't won any of their four away games.
Our numbers lean to Leeds United, thirty-eight percent to thirty-four.
Our call: Leeds United don't lose.

battles.story: Forest: two points above the drop zone, two defeats in a row. Arsenal: going for a third straight win.
say: Second battle, at half past four. Forest are two points above the drop zone, and have lost their last two. Arsenal are chasing a third straight win.
Our numbers give Arsenal sixty-one percent, and Forest just sixteen.
Our call: Arsenal don't lose.

battles.story: Milan: unbeaten in six league games under Amorim. Against Atalanta: no win in their last six league meetings.
say: Then Milan and Atalanta. Milan are unbeaten in six league games under Amorim, but they haven't beaten Atalanta in their last six league meetings.
Our numbers still back Milan, forty-seven percent to twenty-six.
Our call: Milan don't lose.

battles.story: Lazio: no points dropped away from home. Juventus: one win in their last four league games.
say: At quarter to eight, Juventus host Lazio. Lazio haven't dropped a point away from home, and Juventus have one win in their last four league games.
But our numbers back Juventus, fifty-one percent to twenty-three.
Our call: Juventus don't lose.

battles.story: Sevilla: 15 games without a win against Real Madrid, with 13 defeats.
say: And the big one, at eight o'clock. Sevilla haven't beaten Real Madrid in fifteen games, and have lost thirteen of them.
Our numbers give Real Madrid seventy-three percent, and Sevilla just ten.
Our call: a Real Madrid win.
Also today, Celtic host Hearts, after losing four of their last five.
And Ajax go to Groningen, without a win in three.

cards.note: Palace are unbeaten in their last four against Brighton.
Angers have not beaten Marseille in nine meetings.
Fiorentina are second from bottom, with one league win.
Leverkusen go for five wins in a row. Freiburg are unbeaten in nine.
Celtic have lost four of their last five games.
Groningen are unbeaten in four. Ajax are winless in three.
Lorient can beat Monaco for a third league game in a row.
Nice haven't won a league game away from home since March.

end.text: Five calls, judged on the result.
say: Five battles, five calls.
Which one are you watching? Tell us in the comments, and follow for the results.
